title: Allow dictionary overrides through style-profile rules
description: Let profiles extend or override the packaged dictionary (project-specific approved words and technical names) via the rules section, reusing the RULES_FIELD_NAMES validation pattern; unknown keys must fail validation.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Overrides via the asdSte100 profile section: approvedWords, technicalNames, unapprovedWords ({word, approvedAlternative}) with strict validation (_parse_asd_unapproved_words, unknown entry keys fail). Deviation from the filed wording: implemented in the asdSte100 section rather than the generic rules section, to keep rule-set config together; same RULES_FIELD_NAMES-style validation pattern.
